x_note: MapPID controller data (Documents/Notes/Controllers/DieuKhien_MapPID.txt). Ts_ctrl: controller period [s]. The Map branch (calibration points of the dry-road assist) is read from data/map.json, never copied here. design: written by Controllers/MapPID/script/select_mappid.m, fields Kmax (slope limit of the table), lead {z, p} and lag {z1, p1} [rad/s] (Map branch only), Kp, Ki [1/s], Kd [s], Tf [s] (PID branch), Kaw = Ki/(Kp+Kmax). Absent until the optimisation has chosen a point: load_mappid.m then loads the Map design of map.json with all PID gains 0, so MapPID equals Map (the check of build_mappid / test_mappid).

design.rule: min J = R*S by simultaneous optimisation (surrogateopt x3 + patternsearch x3), QuyChuan 6.1 exception
